rounds.title: Plucking rounds
rounds.empty: No plucking rounds yet. Start one when the plucker arrives.

new.title: New plucking round
new.intro: Select the trees the plucker will climb on this visit. He can pluck them in any order.
new.selectedHint: Tap trees to select them. The order you tap is kept.
new.noTrees: No active trees yet. Register your trees first.
new.failed: Couldn't start the round. Please try again.

capture.title: Round {{date}}
capture.addTitle: Add a tree to this round
capture.invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 500.
capture.failed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
capture.conflict: This round changed on another device. Reloading…

review.title: Review round
review.pendingWarning_one: {{count}} tree has no count. It will be marked as skipped, not zero.
review.pendingWarning_other: {{count}} trees have no count. They will be marked as skipped, not zero.
review.confirm: Completing adds {{nuts}} coconuts to your stock. Recorded counts can still be corrected later.
review.needOne: Record at least one tree before completing.
review.done: Round complete. {{nuts}} coconuts added to stock.
review.waitForSend_one: {{count}} count is still on this phone. Complete the round once it has been sent (it sends by itself when there is signal).
review.waitForSend_other: {{count}} counts are still on this phone. Complete the round once they have been sent (they send by themselves when there is signal).

detail.noRecords: No trees were recorded in this round.

correct.title: Correct {{code}}
correct.intro: This round is complete. Changing the count also corrects the coconut stock from this round.
correct.invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 500.
correct.removeConfirm: Remove the record for {{code}}? Its nuts are taken out of totals, stock and predictions. An admin can restore it.
correct.stockUsed: Some of these nuts were already sold, used or dehusked, so stock can't go that low. Adjust the stock first.
correct.failed: Couldn't save the correction. Please try again.

removed.title: Removed records
removed.roundBanner: This round was removed. Its nuts are not counted in totals, stock or predictions.
removed.removeRoundBody: The round, its tree records and its coconut stock are taken out of totals and predictions. An admin can restore it.
removed.stockUsed: Nuts from this round were already sold, used or dehusked, so it can't be removed. Adjust the stock first.
removed.failed: That didn't work. Reload and try again.
